copy.f678acfa5d07: Yes. Launch access is free. Premium and VIP are prepared for the future; payments are disabled.
copy.9f1b1847b9de: The bot must confirm access: server owner, Manage Server or the configured bot admin role. A visible button does not authorize an action.
copy.6163900858e8: Can the site enable privileged intents?
copy.799290450d5e: No. Server Members and Message Content are configured in the application Developer Portal and require approval when Discord requests it. Server invite permissions are separate.
copy.60e83a36bbf4: They provide signals for staff review: a shared address does not prove two accounts belong to one person. Detection is not guaranteed.
copy.801214eee625: Does activity show all Discord logs?
copy.710cce08116f: Panel activity tracks configuration changes. Event logs and channel destinations require separate configuration.
copy.ee3eb940fe52: Technical preview draft: this notice must be completed before public launch.
copy.c505ca3b3455: Sign-in uses your Discord ID, name, avatar and server list to display the panel. Configuration history may record user and server IDs, setting changes and timestamps. Bot tokens remain on the server. Contact messages are encrypted in the database and, when configured, sent to the project’s private Discord channel, where Discord also processes them.
copy.7bd856203731: The panel uses technical authentication cookies, with no advertising cookies or session recording. Keep me signed in is optional. Language and preferences may be stored on your device. Never include passwords or tokens in support messages.
copy.f82ad6a0625e: Website sign-in does not request your email. Bot verification can compare server-scoped network and browser HMAC fingerprints without retaining the original IP in the fingerprint registry. These are signals, not proof of identity, and do not imply an automatic ban.
copy.8ae76d4b8c2d: The bot includes data export and deletion-request procedures. Their website integration is still in progress. Controller details, privacy contact, legal bases, providers, transfers and retention periods for each data type must be specified before launch.

patch.2026-10-30.0.title: Discord Core artwork touch-up
patch.2026-10-30.0.change.0: Updated Security, Music and Dashboard paintings to correct duplicate ears and distinguish the decorative mask.
patch.2026-10-30.0.change.1: Preserved the environments, poses and panoramic layout.
patch.2026-10-30.1.title: The catalogue follows the current bot
patch.2026-10-30.1.change.0: Catalogue aligned with the official source: 584 entries in 25 categories, with Italian and English descriptions.
patch.2026-10-30.1.change.1: Renamed command signatures updated, with AI, Backup, Clan, Economy and separate app categories added.
patch.2026-10-30.1.change.2: Compact category picker; the three Apps context-menu actions are distinct from slash commands.
patch.2026-10-29.2.title: Module changes without silent overwrites
patch.2026-10-29.2.change.0: The dashboard sends the state it observed before changing a module.
patch.2026-10-29.2.change.1: If that state changed elsewhere, the backend rejects the request and the dashboard reloads it without automatically repeating the action.
patch.2026-10-29.2.change.2: Requests that leave the state unchanged do not add duplicate history entries.
patch.2026-10-29.3.title: A clearer control room
patch.2026-10-29.3.change.0: Find servers by name or ID and filter by management access, invite status or membership.
patch.2026-10-29.3.change.1: Bilingual module descriptions and backend-provided Premium/VIP requirements.
patch.2026-10-29.3.change.2: Explicit handling of expired sessions, unavailable history and unconfirmed saves.
patch.2026-10-29.3.change.3: A collapsible phone server picker leaves more room for the dashboard.
patch.2026-10-29.4.title: Commands in two languages
patch.2026-10-29.4.change.0: All 252 catalogue descriptions are now available in English, with original command names preserved.
patch.2026-10-29.4.change.1: Search recognizes Italian and English words in either language.
patch.2026-10-29.5.title: The command library
patch.2026-10-29.5.change.0: A new catalogue with multi-word search, category filters and quick command copying.
patch.2026-10-29.5.change.1: Keyboard navigation keeps focus in the dialog; Escape closes it and restores focus to its trigger.
patch.2026-10-29.5.change.2: Clearer desktop and phone layouts, with empty-search and loading-error states.
patch.2026-10-29.6.title: A wider horizon
patch.2026-10-29.6.change.0: Panoramic21:9 paintings with softly extended sides on wider monitors.
patch.2026-10-29.6.change.1: New mobile menu, translucent toolbar and quick actions on the Discord Core home.
patch.2026-10-29.6.change.2: Optional persistent sign-in and a revision archive.
patch.2026-10-29.7.title: The control room takes shape
patch.2026-10-29.7.change.0: Dashboard preview with identities, servers, modules and Premium/VIP plans.
patch.2026-10-29.7.change.1: Fixed identity scrolling, continuously animated flames and a new scroll.
